premises.text: Online fashion lacks personalization of fit; clothes on standard models leave shoppers unsure, so most fashion still sells in stores
premises.evidence_span: What's missing in online fashion shopping is personalization. People still don't know how clothes fit when they're buying online

premises.text: Shoppers create a personal true-to-size 3D model from two brand/size questions and try on items in-browser without special hardware
premises.evidence_span: Creating a model is as simple as answering just two basic questions. Not 15,000 questions, just two basic questions

premises.text: Fitikit digitizes designer collections at high throughput and delivers them to retailers via API with no retailer upfront cost
premises.evidence_span: We work with fashion designers and digitize their collection. The cool thing about this process is scalability. We can process thousands of items per day

premises.text: Retailers pay as they go and gain increased sales, reduced returns, and fit/style analytics
premises.evidence_span: The retailers have no upfront costs. They pay us as they go. They get increased sales, reduced returns, and they get access to this amazing data

domains.name: Designer digitization and retailer API economics

value.text: Let online shoppers see how clothes truly fit on their body before buying
value.evidence_span: People still don't know how clothes fit when they're buying online

secondary_value.text: Help retailers cut returns and grow online fashion sales
secondary_value.evidence_span: They get increased sales, reduced returns
